title: 第2789章 趁机拿捏第2788章 敲一笔来当贺礼
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
女人。
来找灵宣的？
还找上门来了？
听到这，车中三人均不由自主地吃了一惊。
轩辕封掀开车帘一角，一看在大门左侧处，停着一辆马车。
“是谁，有无报上名姓？”
“没有。”
“那为何不把她们赶走？”
这里是登天阁的分部，又非仙灵皇朝的那个总部，为何有人来此找人？
“少阁主，这车上有三人，俱是女子。连驾车的也是女子，应该是侍女，而且受了伤。”
“不知为何，她们到了这里便不走了，后边好像还有一帮人吊着。正因为如此，小的们还怕受牵扯，我等便要赶走她们。”
“她们不愿离开，后来其中人说是来找灵宣公主的。我们也知道少阁主与公主的关系，便不再赶她们，但也没放她们入内。”
“是这样啊，她们为何又不愿自报家门？她们是否想找我登天阁当挡箭牌的？”
现在的这对灵家姐妹，差不多是名满天下，有人知晓其名不算什么事。
“既然她们不愿自报家门，也不通名报姓，把她们赶走吧。”
想到这层关系，轩辕封也觉得多一事不如少一事。
“等等，姐夫，你让这位统领问一声，她们的姓便可。”
灵宣同在车中，自然听到轩辕封与那个护卫头领间的对话。心中一动，简道。
“听见没，去问一下她的姓即可。”
于是，轩辕封下令道。

“少阁主，她们中一人说了，她姓孔，来自孔雀皇朝。”
“什么，姓孔，来自孔雀皇朝？嘿嘿，我还没去找他们晦气，他们还敢送上门来。”
一听这些人来自孔雀皇朝，轩辕封便气不打一处来。
“姐夫，你与孔雀皇朝的人有过节？”
这时，灵宣又问了一句。
“是啊，但不是与我，是与我登天阁的一笔旧账。”
“这，这。”
“怎么啦，宣妹与他们熟？”
听到灵宣吞吞吐吐那样，轩辕封突然想到，这些人是来找灵宣的。那么或许她们之间有关系，便问道。
“姐夫，我实话实说了，这几人可能是我夫君的人。”
“什么，是我兄弟的人，还仨？”
“姐夫，具体身份我也不知。但听夫君打趣过，说孔雀皇朝的一位郡主，是夫君的侍女。”
“什么，皇朝郡主当侍女，这是啥时候的事？他不是刚上界不久吗？”
听罢这话，轩辕封也是大吃一惊。
“是这样的，当年还在下界时，夫君便把那郡主收下了。”
content_en:
woman.
Are you here to find Lingxuan?
Did you even come to your door?
Hearing this, the three people in the car were involuntarily startled.
Xuanyuan Feng opened the corner of the curtain and saw a carriage parked on the left side of the gate.
"Who is it? Did you give your name?"
"No."
"Then why not drive them away?"
This is a branch of Dengtian Pavilion, not the headquarters of the Fairy Dynasty. Why do people come here to look for someone?
"Young Pavilion Master, there are three people in this car, all of them are women. Even the driver is a woman, she should be a maid, and she is injured."
"For some reason, they didn't leave when they got here. There seems to be a group of people hanging behind them. Because of this, the little ones are still afraid of being involved, so we will drive them away soon."
"They didn't want to leave. Later, one of them said they came to see Princess Lingxuan. We also knew the relationship between the Young Pavilion Master and the princess, so we stopped chasing them away, but we didn't let them in either."
"That's right. Why don't they want to tell themselves their family background? Do they want to use me as a shield for Dengtian Pavilion?"
Nowadays, the Ling family sisters are almost famous all over the world, and it is not a big deal if someone knows their names.
"Since they don't want to announce their family status or their names, let's drive them away."
Thinking of this relationship, Xuanyuan Feng also felt that it was better to do less than to do more.
"Wait a minute, brother-in-law, just ask the commander for their last names."
Lingxuan was in the car with him and naturally heard the conversation between Xuanyuan Feng and the guard leader. With a thought in his heart, he said simply.
"Did you hear that? Just ask her for her last name."
So, Xuanyuan Feng ordered.
"Young Pavilion Master, one of them said that her surname is Kong and she comes from the Peacock Dynasty."
"What, your surname is Kong, from the Mauryan Dynasty? Hehe, I haven't even tried to bring bad luck to them, but they still dare to come to my door."
Xuanyuan Feng became furious when he heard that these people were from the Peacock Dynasty.
"Brother-in-law, do you have any issues with people from the Peacock Dynasty?"
At this time, Lingxuan asked again.
"Yeah, but it's not with me, it's an old score with me at Dengtian Pavilion."
"This, this."
"What's the matter? Xuanmei is familiar with them?"
Hearing Lingxuan's hesitation, Xuanyuan Feng suddenly thought that these people were here to find Lingxuan. Then maybe there is a relationship between them, he asked.
"Brother-in-law, I'm telling the truth, these people may be my husband's people."
"What, my brother's people, three of them?"
"Brother-in-law, I don't know your specific identity. But I heard my husband joke that a princess from the Peacock Dynasty was my husband's maid."
"What, the Princess of the Imperial Dynasty became a maid, when did this happen? Didn't he just come to the world not long ago?"
After hearing this, Xuanyuan Feng was also shocked.
"It's like this. When I was still in the lower realm, my husband took the princess under his wing."
